newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia April export prices rise 0.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Australia April export prices rise 0.8 pct.

text.p: Australian export prices rose 0.8 percent in April from a month earlier and were 1.6 percent lower than a year earlier, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Monday.
The bureau said higher prices for wool, some types of coal, and aluminium and alumina fuelled the monthly rise.
"Partly offsetting these increases were price decreases for petroleum gases and cotton," thebureau said.

The annual change in the export price index has been in steady decline since February, 1996. The monthly change has also generally been down, with the latest figure only the fourth monthly increase in 15 months.
